2026-08-26T09:18:40.8727099Z ```bash

2026-08-26T09:18:40.8729693Z   '{discussion_number: ($discussion_number|tonumber), body: .}' \
2026-08-26T09:18:40.8731029Z   discussion-body.md \
2026-08-26T09:18:40.8732012Z   | safeoutputs update_discussion .
2026-08-26T09:18:40.8733044Z ```
2026-08-26T09:18:40.8735596Z `jq -Rs` reads the file as a raw string (`-R`) and slurps it into a single JSON string value (`-s`), so `body` is always a valid JSON field. Piping `cat file | safeoutputs ...` does not populate `body` and will be rejected.
